methods.what: Euler product over primes below a bound K, combined over two classes of primes p and q and compared with m^{1/2} times a Dirichlet-type series
First-order approximation of the logarithms of the product factors, -log(1-1/p) ≈ 1/p
Sums over primes replaced by integrals of dx/(x log x), giving log log K terms
Resulting estimate in terms of a ratio of logarithms
Lemniscatic elliptic integral, with factorisation of 1-x^4 and periods n+mω, (n+mi)ω
